#+TODO: NEXT WAITING | FINISHED CANCELLED
Expected: keywords from the #+TODO line are recognized: "Plan trip" [NEXT],
"Book hotel" [WAITING], "Buy tickets" [FINISHED], "Old idea" [CANCELLED].
"TODO" is not a keyword in this file once #+TODO redefines them, so "TODO is text" keeps it.
Links keep their description: "Read the docs".

* NEXT Plan trip
** WAITING Book hotel
** FINISHED Buy tickets
* CANCELLED Old idea
* TODO is text
